note: The Comoros: every visitor, whatever the nationality, gets a visa on arrival for up to 45 days (EUR 30), with a return or onward ticket. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Comoros
sources.said: All visitors regardless of nationality to Comoros are required to have a valid visa (unless otherwise exempted). Nationals of any country can obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 45 days at a cost of Euro 30 each.
